About the Brand

Something sweet,
charming & dear

Drawn from the French phrase mon petit chou chou, Petite Chou is a handmade jewellery and accessories brand built around playful personalisation, bold colour, and everyday elegance. Founded in November 2021, the brand has rapidly become synonymous with fun, expression, and meticulous craft.

"Unique, elegant designs that feel both personal and timeless — allowing customers to express their individuality while embracing everyday beauty."

The Proposal
Collaboration Concept

Footwear as
wearable
storytelling

An interactive Brooch Bar & Charm Bar experience within Birkenstock retail environments — allowing customers to personalise their Boston shoes with collectible, handpicked charm brooches that reflect their individual story.

I
Interactive In-Store Experience
A curated charm display inviting hands-on personalisation — customers select, compose, and style their own brooch arrangement.
II
Up to 5 Charms per Brooch
Pearls, enamel, semi-precious stones, evil eyes, miniature figurines — sourced to match a defined seasonal aesthetic.
III
Boston Bead Bag Take-Home Kit
A collectible kit — beads, alphabet letters, colourful paracord — for customers to continue creating at home.

Charm Aesthetics

Three
worlds

Charms sourced around defined aesthetic directions, each creating a distinct emotional language for the customer.

I
Coastal Luxe
Shells, pearls, coral — evoking the Australian coastline through tactile, sun-bleached materials.
II
French Apothecary
Enamel botanicals, vintage keys, cloisonné — drawn from a Parisian cabinet of curiosities.
III
Modern Talisman
Evil eyes, hamsa hands, chilli pendants — protective symbolism in contemporary materials.
